answer.answer: The dataset provides only one aggregate row for Law et al. 2014 (p10/median/p90 for the whole 2001–2012 period), with no year-by-year breakdown, so a first-third vs last-third comparison cannot be computed. Even if it could, a single study's net-tow concentrations cannot establish a Pacific-wide temporal trend.
